'''Erikson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he worked as a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] on [[Station Gamma]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. As Station Gamma had been overran by the [[Rak'qua]], a tribe of bellicose [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]], Erikson preferred to stay in the neutral area at the entrance of the station. There, he used to buy [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts, old weapons and various other things from brave [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who survived their exploration of Station Gamma.<ref name="SWG:SG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Erikson appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Erikson was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:SG" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
